name: Ray-marching boundary clipping
aliases: Clipping via Ray Marching Boundary Check
Ray-marching volume clipping via boundary check
definition: A technique to clip a volume during ray marching by preventing color and alpha accumulation when the ray position is outside a defined clipping box, rather than discarding the final pixel in the fragment shader.
summary: Ray-marching boundary clipping prevents black artifacts by skipping color accumulation outside a defined box, unlike fragment discarding which hides pixels entirely.
